scope: Corollary 2.7 of the manuscript “Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar” (preprints/Rigidity-of-Smooth-Billiards-with-a-Continuous-Caustic-Collar-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fefc18481d52acb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the actual table, the normalized action in Equation (2.5) is holomorphic in a neighborhood of the real diagonal, diagonally 2π-periodic, and antisymmetric. It satisfies D(X, X + T) = −T3 /24 + O(T5 ), D1(X, X + T) = T2 /8 + O(T4 ), locally uniformly with all fixed derivatives. The unique rational graphs and their identities in Theorem 2.2 are available for every sufficiently small positive reduced l/q.
